lane: MINEXP - lane 25 - minimum decisive Hall-only / RF+Hall / ECR+Hall experiment
not_frozen: Nothing in this file is pre-registered or approved. Every threshold is PROPOSED for the owner. No score-bearing measurement may be taken before the pre-registration step (section 'preregistration') is completed, approved by the owner and hash-locked.

scope.question: At a common feed state and a common DC bus boundary, does adding an RF or an ECR pre-ionizer in front of the same Hall accelerator raise thrust per bus watt (or enable sustained operation) relative to Hall-only, at the operating points that bound the feed envelope?
scope.when_to_run: Only if the literature/model evidence (docs/evidence/rf_source/, docs/evidence/ecr_source/, docs/evidence/hall_sustainment/) remains insufficient to settle the ambiguity. This draft does not judge that sufficiency.
scope.what_it_is_not: Not a performance prediction, not a winner declaration, not a Hall transport validation. It produces measured, paired, common-boundary evidence on the tested hardware and a per-arm, per-point classification for the owner.
scope.rfp_context: RFP DTDF/06/13516 envelope (CLAUDE.md): 180-230 km, 12-25 mN, < 1.5 kW, < 40 kg, 26,000 h mission, > 15,000 h firing, Hall preferred, air + Xe.

rules_compliance: No Hall transport closure, screening candidate (sgb-screen-*) or withdrawn 0-D Hall result is used as a performance source; the break-even is evaluated only from paired measurements.
P5 calibration nuisance (p5_registration, p5_coil_shape, beam_efficiency_reading, facility_ingestion_interpretation) is never an axis, factor or design variable here.

Hall-closure uncertainty never leaks upstream: the feed state is an input fixed by the upstream ICD (IF-A5) and is identical for all arms; compressor and other upstream loads enter the bus sum as explicit ledger inputs identical across arms.
Every numeric value carries a source and an evidence class, or is 'TBD - requires ...'. Thresholds not in the RFP are PROPOSED. Missing inputs raise in the derivation script (no defaults).

Eliminations happen only through explicit rules (hard gate G-SRC on a measured source-sustainment failure; PROPOSED stop rule D3 on measured paired data). No rule stops an arm on literature or model evidence alone.
Other lanes' artefacts are referenced by repository path only and are not required by this draft or its test.

A.delivers: Per-arm, per-point classes (SOURCE_BETTER / EQUIVALENT / SOURCE_WORSE / ENABLES / UNRESOLVED / FACILITY_CONDITIONAL) measured on common hardware and a common bus boundary, plus the conditions under which they hold; enough for an owner statement of the form 'architecture X is baseline provided conditions A/B/C are demonstrated'. Does not require Physics Baseline 1.0.
A.to_reach: S0-S4 complete for at least the hall_only arm and every non-stopped source arm; S5 for the facility qualifier.

B.delivers: Transport-independent source boundary data (P_src,bus, I_src, I_del, eta_ts, delivered-ion energy and species) and Vyovrinda-hardware Hall data (B(z) maps, geometry, coil currents, I_d traces, species fractions, divergence) that an admitted Hall closure would need to turn tested points into design envelopes.
B.still_needed: An admitted Hall transport closure (credible set currently empty: CLAUDE.md gate 3), O/O2 chemistry for air (CLAUDE.md next work 4; the air surrogate here has no atomic O), and, if the physics track wants these data as promotion evidence, its own pre-registration before the measurement.

C.delivers: Measured bus-power ledger entries per consumer at the tested points and source waste-heat inputs.
C.still_needed: Mass, thermal, life (docs/evidence/wall_life/, abep_sim/thermal_life.py), startup, cathode (docs/evidence/cathode/) and mission closure integrated; flight-representative PPU and generator; not supported by this experiment alone.

milestones.fastest_route: This is the fastest physical route to milestone A, and a direct input to milestone B once a closure is admitted.

accelerator.geometry_and_Bz: TBD - requires the Vyovrinda Hall design; B(z) is measured in S1 for every hardware configuration (P5 lesson: unpublished coil currents/B(z) made P5 transport non-identifiable, CLAUDE.md next work 1).

cathode.definition: One physical cathode unit, same position, same flow and keeper setting in every arm.
cathode.type: TBD - requires the cathode lane decision (docs/evidence/cathode/).

feed_state.definition: For a given operating point: identical anode mass flow, composition (same mass-flow controllers and gas bottles), cathode flow and gas supply temperature in every arm.
feed_state.fields: schemas/interfaces/upstream_icd_v1.json IF-A5 (mdot_total_kgps, mdot_s_kgps, w_s, x_s, p_feed_Pa, T_gas_K) and IF-X2 (mdot_xe_cathode_kgps)
feed_state.values: TBD - requires the feed envelope from the upstream ICD (IF-A5) and the design point

common_elements.discharge_voltage: Same V_d setpoint per operating point in every arm.
common_elements.facility_and_instruments: Same chamber, thrust stand, power analyzer channels, gauges, probes and calibration standards for every arm.
common_elements.only_difference: The pre-ionizer module (none / RF / ECR), the gas path through it (inherent to the architecture), and its arm-specific bus components.

hardware_configurations.description: H-1 + flow-equivalent feed spacer replicating the source module's mechanical envelope and gas path, with no source hardware.
hardware_configurations.note: True hall_only reference. Measured first and last (re-mount reproducibility).

hardware_configurations.description: H-1 + RF source module + interstage + DC-input RF generator + matching network.
hardware_configurations.note: Source-unpowered state = installed-off reference (within-configuration pairing, installation effect vs HW-0).

hardware_configurations.description: H-1 + ECR source module + interstage + DC-input microwave generator + waveguide/antenna + ECR magnet.
hardware_configurations.note: If the ECR field comes from permanent magnets, the installed-off state is not hall_only-equivalent; B(z) mapping in S1 quantifies the perturbation of the Hall field.

hardware_configurations.description: PROPOSED hardware option: an in-vacuum feed-path diverter that routes the gas either through the source module or directly to the anode distributor without venting.
hardware_configurations.note: Removes the re-mount term G5 from the hall_only comparison; needs one check against true HW-0. Owner decision (hardware cost).

bus_power_boundary.module: abep_sim/arch_boundary.py (other lane; referenced by path, not imported)

measured_in_experiment.cathode_heater: load side V, I (startup only; reported, steady-state value expected 0 if the heater is off)

measured_in_experiment.rf_source: DC input power of the RF generator (bus side); forward and reflected RF power as diagnostics
measured_in_experiment.ecr_source: DC input power of the microwave generator (bus side); forward and reflected power as diagnostics

measured_in_experiment.housekeeping: not present in the lab: explicit ledger input, identical for all arms

bus_power_boundary.note: Common unmeasured loads (compressor, housekeeping) enter P_bus of every arm; they dilute R toward 1 and raise the break-even cost C*. R is reported both with lab-measured consumers only and with the full bus_power_boundary_v1 sum; the latter is decisive and states the evidence class of each ledger input.

mdot.values: TBD - requires the feed envelope (schemas/interfaces/upstream_icd_v1.json IF-A5 mdot_total_kgps) for mdot_min and mdot_nom; mdot_knee is located by the S2 knee scan under rule T-OP2-FALLBACK

p.definition: feed / source-chamber absolute pressure (capacitance manometer) and background pressure p_b
p.reason: With fixed hardware, p follows mdot and the conductance of the source/interstage; setting it independently needs a variable conductance (hardware change, not minimal). The rig's (mdot, p) relation is compared with IF-A5 p_feed_Pa; mismatch is an applicability limit.

V_d.values: TBD - requires the Hall design point and the bus allocation; V_hi only for hall_only iso-power references and must bracket the source-on bus power (no extrapolation)

P_source.role: set factor (source arms only; 0 for hall_only)
P_source.values: P_hi: TBD - requires the source allocation in bus_power_boundary_v1; P_lo per rule T-PLO-FRACTION

operating_points.why: Lower edge of the feed envelope; where Hall-only ionization is weakest and sustainment may fail (enablement test).
Hall-only sustainment knee; hypothesised sign change of the source benefit (hypothesis, not evidence).
Nominal feed; where Hall-only is expected to be strongest; the other side of the break-even surface.
hall_only only: iso-power reference (raise V_d instead of powering a source).
hall_only only: iso-power reference at nominal flow.
Composition transfer check at the most sensitive flow; enablement on air if hall_only fails there.

knee_scan.levels: T-KNEE-LEVELS equally spaced mass flows from mdot_nom down to mdot_min, then back up (hysteresis check)
knee_scan.output: SUSTAINED flag per level (rule T-SUSTAIN), I_d traces, thrust where sustained

run_matrix.description: Hall-on conditions. Each condition is measured in every block (n blocks, rule T-N-MIN/T-N-MAX). 'families' lists the comparison families in which the condition is the source-on member (compared against HW-0 at the same operating point; iso_power against the HW-0 V_nom/V_hi interpolation).

bench_conditions.description: Hall discharge OFF, Hall magnet at the operating coil currents of the matching operating point, same flows and composition. Per source arm: flows of OP1, OP2, OP3 (N2) and OP5 (air surrogate) x source levels lo, hi.
bench_conditions.cathode_state: TBD - requires the full-protocol lane (docs/architecture_comparison/experiment_protocol/) or owner; recorded either way

decisive_quantities.name: delivered ion current
decisive_quantities.definition: Ion current that crosses the Hall channel exit plane with the Hall discharge off and the Hall magnet on (cold transport through the full accelerator geometry), integrated over the beam.

decisive_quantities.name: source bus power
decisive_quantities.definition: DC input power of the source generator (plus ecr_magnet for ecr_hall) on the common bus.

decisive_quantities.name: interstage transport efficiency
decisive_quantities.definition: I_del / I_src, with I_src the ion current leaving the source exit plane.

decisive_quantities.name: change of Hall discharge current
decisive_quantities.definition: I_d(arm X, source on) - I_d(hall_only) at fixed V_d, mdot, composition and coil currents.

decisive_quantities.name: change of thrust
decisive_quantities.definition: T(arm X, source on) - T(hall_only) at the same fixed conditions.

decisive_quantities.name: change of bus power
decisive_quantities.definition: Sum over bus_power_boundary_v1 components (arm X source on) minus the hall_only sum.

derived_metrics.role: explanatory (passive presence of the source hardware); R_arch = R_within * R_install

derived_metrics.definition: T_{X,on} / T_{hall_only}(P_bus = P_bus,X,on), hall_only thrust linearly interpolated between V_nom and V_hi at the same mdot; reported only when bracketed
P_src,bus / I_del  [W/A = V; numerically eV per delivered ion]

derived_metrics.role: break-even delivered-ion cost; R_arch > 1 <=> C_del < C_star

derived_metrics.definition: sqrt(2 m_i V_d / (Z e)) for the heaviest singly charged species in the feed
derived_metrics.role: ion-momentum ceiling used only by the S3 screen

break_even.inequality: R_arch > 1  <=>  dT * P_bus,0 > T_0 * (dP_d,load/eta_d + P_src,bus + dP_other)  <=>  C_del < C_star = y*(P_bus,0/T_0) - kappa*V_d/eta_d - dP_other/I_del
break_even.derivation: P_bus,X = P_bus,0 + V_d*dI_d/eta_d + P_src,bus + dP_other; divide the inequality T_X/P_bus,X > T_0/P_bus,0 by I_del. Identity, no physical assumption; verified numerically by the test with synthetic vectors.
break_even.screen_bound: C_star_ub = y_max * (P_bus,0/T_0) assumes y <= y_max, kappa >= 0 and dP_other >= 0.
break_even.why_screen_only: y can exceed y_max if delivered plasma seeds extra Hall ionization or if Hall-on transport exceeds cold transport; kappa can be negative: the ID-Hall abstract (Martin Ortega et al. 2020, REF-MARTINORTEGA2020) reports that the I-V overshoot of single-stage operation disappears in double-stage operation at intermediate voltages, which the authors read as decreased anomalous electron transport. A Hall-off bound can therefore only prioritise, never stop, an arm. (The ID-Hall concept and its inductive ionization source are described in REF-DUBOIS2018; context only.)
break_even.prior_to_be_tested: CLAUDE.md lists 'RF/helicon pre-ionisers add nothing' as probably robust at mechanism level (independent of the Hall closure); it comes from the project's own models, so it is model-derived and is superseded by hardware measurement within the tested domain (docs/EVIDENCE.md). The helicon-Hall precedent (REF-SHABSHELOWITZ2014, abstract only) reports thrust marginally up and thrust-to-power down with RF power.

measurements.instrument: pendulum-type thrust stand (hanging, inverted or torsional) with in-situ calibration
measurements.practice: REF-POLK2017: end-to-end in-situ calibration under vacuum; at least ten calibrations before and after thruster operation; zero taken with thruster power and flow off before thermal transients drift it; uncertainty reported with an error budget
measurements.requirement: relative random uncertainty per reading u_T <= derived_numbers.u_reading_max_by_n (for the chosen n)
measurements.range: TBD - requires the Hall design thrust range

measurements.instrument: multi-channel DC power analyzer or calibrated shunt/voltage-divider pairs, simultaneous sampling, one channel per bus_power_boundary_v1 component present in the lab; DC input of each source generator measured on its supply side
measurements.practice: calibration traceable to a national standard (owner to specify); same channels for every arm
measurements.requirement: u_P per reading <= derived_numbers.u_reading_max_by_n; source-channel scale uncertainty (incl. generator efficiency if DC input is not measured) <= derived_numbers.u_source_scale_max_by_f_src at the measured f_src

measurements.quantity: forward / reflected RF or microwave power
measurements.instrument: directional coupler + power sensors at the generator output
measurements.practice: diagnostic: coupling and generator DC-to-RF efficiency; not a substitute for the DC input

measurements.instrument: current probe on the anode line, time-synchronised DAQ
measurements.practice: sampling rate TBD - requires the S1 I_d spectrum; traces archived for every reading (P5 lesson: per-point I_d traces were not available)
measurements.requirement: used for T-SUSTAIN (extinction) and oscillation reporting (non-gating)

measurements.instrument: guarded Faraday collector or probe array at the source exit plane (I_src) and a downstream Faraday probe sweep / integrating collector for the Hall channel exit plane with the Hall discharge off (I_del)
measurements.practice: REF-BROWN2017 Table A1: ion-saturation bias characterised across the plume, collector SEE and gap corrections, alignment and cabling rules; the full practice asks for at least four background pressures and four distances, the minimum set uses fewer and states the deviation
measurements.requirement: u(I_del) enters the S3 screen only (conservative direction: a larger u never produces a stop candidate)

measurements.instrument: retarding potential analyser at the interstage/channel exit (S3) and in the far field (S4, both source states)
measurements.practice: diagnostic for delivered-ion energy and for dT decomposition

measurements.quantity: ion species current fractions (N2+, N+, O2+, O+)
measurements.instrument: E x B (Wien filter) probe; with an accelerating bias for low-energy interstage ions
measurements.practice: REF-ROVEY2025: at low energy the four air ion species (m/q 32, 28, 16, 14) are not all resolved without an accelerating bias; the CEX correction's dominant uncertainty is the background neutral density from ion gauges (typically 10-20 %)
measurements.requirement: species if possible; explanatory for milestone B, not decisive

measurements.quantity: far-field ion current density, beam current, divergence
measurements.instrument: far-field Faraday probe sweep (Hall on, both source states)
measurements.practice: REF-BROWN2017 (far field > 4 channel diameters); decomposition of dT into beam current, divergence and voltage terms
measurements.requirement: explanatory; published per point (P5 lesson: per-point divergence missing)

measurements.quantity: background pressure p_b and feed/source pressure p
measurements.instrument: hot-cathode (Bayard-Alpert type) ion gauge(s) for p_b; capacitance diaphragm manometer for p (gas-independent)
measurements.practice: REF-DANKANICH2017 Sec. IV.A: gauge inside the chamber with line of sight to the thruster, near the wall at the thruster exit plane (>= 0.6 chamber radii from the centerline, >= 1 m from the thruster outer diameter), >= 10 Hz sampling, 3 s averages, no reading within 2 min of a > 10 % flow change; calibrate on the gas of interest where practical (nitrogen is the industry standard calibration gas, Sec. II.A.2); report wall temperature at the gauge
measurements.requirement: p_b recorded for every reading; gas-correction for the air surrogate TBD - requires the gauge calibration

measurements.instrument: thermal mass-flow controllers calibrated for N2, O2 and Xe (cathode)
measurements.practice: REF-SNYDER2017 (title/DOI verified only; details to verify)
measurements.requirement: identical setpoints across arms; absolute accuracy matters for mapping to IF-A5, not for the paired ratios

measurements.instrument: Hall-probe gaussmeter on a positioning stage
measurements.practice: mapped for HW-0, HW-RF, HW-ECR (source magnet on/off where applicable) at the operating coil currents, before and after the campaign; published with coil currents
measurements.requirement: TBD - requires the Hall design (field magnitude and gradient) for the probe range and positioning accuracy

measurements.instrument: thermocouples on anode/channel body, magnet circuit, source, generator, cathode mount
measurements.practice: thermal settling detection (T-SETTLE) and thermal_control ledger input
measurements.requirement: TBD - requires S1 thermal time constants

measurements.instrument: optical emission spectroscopy in the source/interstage; residual gas analyser for the chamber background
measurements.practice: qualitative dissociation/excitation indicators; background contamination check with O2 flow
recorded for every reading; same facility grounding for every arm

variance_groups.name: thrust, random per reading (incl. zero and calibration drift)
variance_groups.cancels: the thrust-stand scale factor cancels in the ratio when one in-situ calibration set brackets both conditions

variance_groups.name: bus power, random per reading
variance_groups.cancels: meter scale of a consumer whose power is unchanged between conditions cancels to first order

variance_groups.name: source-power scale (meter scale; generator efficiency if its DC input is not measured)
variance_groups.cancels: does not cancel: the source channel exists in one condition only

variance_groups.name: common-consumer scale and unmeasured common ledger loads (compressor, housekeeping, eta_d)
variance_groups.cancels: partially: weighted by the change of the consumer's share

variance_groups.name: re-mount / between-session reproducibility of ln(T/P_bus), including thrust-stand re-calibration shifts between sessions
variance_groups.cancels: no; estimated from the HW-0 start/end repeat (R02/R03 vs R09/R10); removed by OPTION-DIVERTER

uncertainty.requirement_logic: Classes against the band (-delta, +delta) with simultaneous half-width h = z*sigma are mutually exclusive, and UNRESOLVED is impossible iff h < delta/2 (if a point is not EQUIVALENT then |x| + h >= delta, so |x| >= delta - h > h and the interval excludes 0). Hence sigma(ln R) < delta/(2 z). The budget is split into T-VAR-GROUPS equal variance shares. Non-averaging groups (G3-G5) set a floor delta_floor = 2 z s_nonavg that no number of repeats can beat.
uncertainty.screen_uncertainty: S3 screen: u(ln C_del)^2 = u(P_src,bus)^2 + u(I_del)^2; u(ln C_star_ub)^2 = u_abs(P_bus,0)^2 + u_abs(T_0)^2 (absolute calibrations; scale terms do not cancel here). Stop candidate only if ln C_del - ln C_star_ub > z_screen * sqrt(sum) at every qualifying point.
uncertainty.achievability: TBD - requires S1 measured repeatability (u_T, u_P, u_rm) and calibration certificates. No instrument accuracy is claimed in this draft. If the derived n exceeds T-N-MAX or delta_floor exceeds T-DELTA, the owner decides before any score-bearing run (D0).
uncertainty.p5_lesson: The P5-N2 ingestion correction to I_d was 2.2-3.7 % (docs/EVIDENCE.md register, reconstructed from Brabston Eq. 13/14, REF-BRABSTON2025) and facility-ingestion interpretation became a calibration-nuisance dimension (hallthruster_bridge/ensemble/transport_ensemble_v0.json). That is the same order as delta, so the decisive metric uses raw paired data at measured p_b with no ingestion correction; p_b sensitivity is measured directly in S5.

planning_grids.note: Hypothetical scenarios used only to tabulate derived requirements; they are not claims about any hardware or facility.

f_src.source: lane 25 planning grid (hypothetical source share of bus power)

s_nonaveraging.source: lane 25 planning grid (hypothetical combined non-averaging uncertainty)

delta_alternatives.source: lane 25 planning grid (T-DELTA and one owner alternative)

background_pressure_torr.source: REF-DANKANICH2017 Sec. V: 5e-5 and 1.3e-5 Torr = early SPT-100 guidance for performance and near-field plume measurements; 1e-5 Torr = level below which the SPT-100 transportability study found the thrust-slope change identifiable. Xenon/SPT-100 specific; the authors note that the basis of that guidance does not address applicability beyond the SPT-100 and that the data are insufficient for absolute requirements for general thruster designs. Used here only as planning scenarios.

gauge_wall_temperature_K.source: planning value (room-temperature chamber wall); S_eff scales linearly with it

thresholds.name: equivalence / decision margin on ln R
thresholds.source: lane 25 proposal for owner decision (not in the RFP)
thresholds.rationale: about 5 % in thrust per bus watt; smaller margins raise the required repeats as 1/delta^2 (derived_numbers.n_required)

thresholds.name: family-wise error rate for simultaneous intervals (Bonferroni)
thresholds.rationale: all per-point classes of one family hold simultaneously with >= 95 % confidence

thresholds.name: one-sided error rate for the S3 screen
thresholds.rationale: the screen only reduces the S4 grid; the stop itself needs D3

thresholds.name: minimum blocks per condition
thresholds.rationale: even number: alternating source-level order cancels linear drift over block pairs

thresholds.name: maximum blocks per condition
thresholds.rationale: caps campaign length; beyond it the owner changes delta or instruments (D0)

thresholds.name: number of equal variance shares in the uncertainty budget
thresholds.rationale: transparent default allocation over G1-G5; the owner may re-allocate after S1

thresholds.name: elevated background pressure for the S5 facility check
thresholds.source: lane 25 proposal; method from REF-DANKANICH2017 Sec. IV.B (supplemental primary gas >= 2 m downstream, a pumping surface between injection and gauge)
thresholds.rationale: measures the sign and size of the p_b sensitivity without an ingestion model

thresholds.name: maximum base background pressure for a scoreable Hall-on reading
thresholds.value: TBD - requires S1 facility characterization and an owner decision; REF-DANKANICH2017 Sec. V guidance values are SPT-100/xenon specific and not transferable

thresholds.name: mass-flow levels in the S2 knee scan
thresholds.rationale: locates the knee to one quarter of the mdot_min-mdot_nom interval

thresholds.name: definition of mdot_knee
thresholds.rule: mdot_knee = the lowest scan level at which hall_only is SUSTAINED in both scan directions; if every level is sustained, mdot_knee = arithmetic midpoint of mdot_min and mdot_nom; if no level is sustained, mdot_knee = mdot_nom and every point is an enablement test

thresholds.name: low source power level
thresholds.rationale: P_lo = max(lowest stably sustained source power at that flow from S3, 0.5 * P_hi): two levels give the marginal yield and straddle the unknown dependence of C_del on power

thresholds.name: sustainment rule
thresholds.rule: SUSTAINED = the discharge runs for the whole dwell without extinction or automatic restart; oscillation amplitude is reported, not gating
thresholds.dwell: TBD - requires S1 thermal settling time

thresholds.name: thermal settling before a reading
thresholds.value: TBD - requires S1 thermal time constants (M12) and thrust-stand drift data

thresholds.name: S3 stop-candidate screen (D2)
thresholds.rule: An arm is a STOP_CANDIDATE if hall_only is SUSTAINED at every grid operating point AND at every one of them ln C_del - ln C_star_ub > z_screen_one_sided * u_combined. A stop candidate runs only the confirmation subset in S4. The screen never stops an arm.

thresholds.name: arm stop (D3)
thresholds.rule: STOP the arm if (a) at every tested operating point where hall_only is SUSTAINED the R_arch class is SOURCE_WORSE (equivalently C_del > C_star with simultaneous confidence), (b) no R_iso class is SOURCE_BETTER, (c) the arm ENABLES at no point, and (d) when stopping from the confirmation subset, the screen assumptions are not contradicted there (y - z_screen_one_sided*u(y) <= y_max and kappa + z_screen_one_sided*u(kappa) >= 0 at every subset point). EQUIVALENT never stops an arm; it is reported to the owner.

thresholds.name: facility robustness qualifier (S5)
thresholds.rule: FACILITY_ROBUST if the R_arch class at base p_b equals the class at T-PB-ELEV-FACTOR x base p_b; otherwise FACILITY_CONDITIONAL. No ingestion correction is applied to rescue a class.

thresholds.name: readiness gate (D0)
thresholds.rule: Before any score-bearing run: calibrations done (M1, M2, M9, M10), B(z) mapped for every configuration (M11), derived n <= T-N-MAX at T-DELTA from S1 repeatability, delta_floor(measured non-averaging terms) < T-DELTA, base p_b <= T-PB-MAX at every grid flow. Otherwise the owner decides (raise delta, improve instruments, adopt OPTION-DIVERTER, or move facility).

randomization.configuration_order: HW-0 first and last; the order of HW-RF and HW-ECR between them is drawn by a seeded coin (seed fixed and published in the pre-registration).
randomization.block: One block = one visit of every condition of the current configuration. Operating-point order within a block is a seeded random permutation, re-drawn per block.
randomization.within_point_order: At each operating point of a source configuration: off, lo, hi, off in odd blocks and off, hi, lo, off in even blocks; the two 'off' readings bracket drift and linear drift cancels over block pairs. Thrust zero taken at the end of each point visit (REF-POLK2017).
randomization.seed: TBD - requires the pre-registration (publicly drawn, recorded in the lock file)
randomization.blinding: Analysis runs only through the frozen, hash-locked script after the raw dataset is frozen and hashed (score once), mirroring the P5-N2 practice (hallthruster_bridge/prereg/p5_n2_prereg_lock_v1.json).

repeatability.blocks: n between T-N-MIN and T-N-MAX, fixed at D0 from S1 repeatability by derived_numbers.n_required logic; never changed after the first score-bearing reading
repeatability.day_effect: blocks on different days where possible; day recorded as a covariate
repeatability.remount: HW-0 at OP2 and OP3 repeated after re-mounting at the end (R09, R10) gives u_rm (G5)
repeatability.hysteresis: S2 knee scan descending and ascending

facility_controls.background_pressure: M9 per REF-DANKANICH2017; every reading carries p_b; base p_b must satisfy T-PB-MAX
facility_controls.facility_effect_check: S5 at OP2 and OP3 for hall_only and every non-stopped source arm at P_hi (R07, R08, R22-R25, R37-R40), elevated p_b by supplemental N2 injection per REF-DANKANICH2017 Sec. IV.B
facility_controls.no_correction_in_decisive_metric: Raw paired data are decisive; any ingestion-corrected value is secondary, versioned and reported beside the raw value (P5-N2 lesson).
facility_controls.electrical: same grounding and cable routing for every arm; M14 recorded
facility_controls.gas_safety: facility compatibility with O2 flow (pump type, safety case): TBD - requires facility data
facility_controls.publish: B(z) maps and coil currents, channel geometry, I_d traces, per-point divergence, p_b location and gauge calibration are published with the dataset (the items whose absence made P5 non-identifiable)

facility_split.method: Required effective pumping speed S_eff = Q / p_b,max with Q = (mdot_total/m) k_B T at the gauge-wall temperature (derived_numbers.S_eff_required_per_mgps gives S_eff per mg/s of N2 or O2). Whether a facility qualifies for a stage follows from its published S_eff and the grid's largest total flow (anode + cathode): TBD - requires the IF-A5 feed envelope and T-PB-MAX.

stages.S1_instrument_qualification: power-chain, flow-controller and gauge calibrations; B(z) mapping (magnetostatic, possible at atmosphere at room temperature; hot-state effects TBD): no large chamber needed
stages.S3_source_bench: Hall discharge off; needs vacuum at the grid flows with p_b low enough that CEX loss over the collector path is bounded (attenuation form exp(-n0 sigma z) as in REF-ROVEY2025 Eq. 37; sigma for N2+ on N2 TBD - requires a cited cross section). A smaller facility may suffice if its S_eff meets this bound: TBD
stages.S2_S4_S5_hall_on: thrust at grid flows with p_b <= T-PB-MAX and the ability to raise p_b by supplemental injection; S_eff from derived_numbers.S_eff_required_per_mgps; likely a larger chamber at nominal flow, TBD - requires the feed envelope

facility_split.iist: Published information (REF-IIST-WEB, accessed 2026-09-26): IIST collaborates in the LPSC-led 'High Thrust Electric Propulsion' inter-centre project on the design, development, testing and implementation of diagnostic tools for characterising the Stationary Plasma Thruster being developed by LPSC; it developed a back-diffusion plasma source and an ion beam source in-house, and states that its plasma facility can be tuned to lower-ionospheric conditions ('India's only ionospheric plasma simulator'). No chamber dimensions, base pressure or pumping speed were found in published sources. Suitability for any stage is TBD - requires the facility's specification (obtaining it and any discussion are the owner's decision; this lane made no contact).
facility_split.commitments: None. Nothing here commits any institution, facility or person.

stages.output: owner-approved thresholds (replacing PROPOSED), frozen analysis script and seed, hash lock

stages.name: instrument and facility qualification
stages.output: calibrations, B(z) maps (HW-0, HW-RF, HW-ECR), repeatability u_T, u_P, cold-flow p_b vs flow, thermal time constants

stages.name: hall_only on HW-0
stages.output: knee scan, SUSTAINED map, T_0, P_bus,0, I_d traces at R01-R06

stages.name: source bench, Hall discharge off
stages.output: P_src,bus, I_src, I_del, eta_ts, C_del, ion energy/species per arm (bench_conditions)

stages.name: paired Hall-on, source arms
stages.output: R_arch, R_within, R_install, R_iso, y, kappa, C_star, ENABLES flags

stages.name: re-mount repeat, freeze, score once, report
stages.output: u_rm, frozen raw dataset hash, per-arm per-point classes with conditions, milestone-A condition statements for the owner

outcomes.always: fix mdot_knee; flag points where hall_only is not SUSTAINED as enablement tests; go to S3

decisions.rule: hard gate (measured): a source that cannot sustain its plasma at a grid flow within P_hi, with the Hall discharge off (S3) and in one Hall-on attempt at P_hi (S4), is INFEASIBLE_AT_POINT there; an arm infeasible at every grid flow is STOPPED (hard gate, measured)

outcomes.stop_candidate: S4 confirmation subset only (rows with confirmation_subset = true)

outcomes.stop: arm STOPPED; remaining rows of the arm not run
outcomes.continue_from_subset: run the rest of S4 for the arm

outcomes.always: qualify each class as FACILITY_ROBUST or FACILITY_CONDITIONAL; go to S6

decisions.rule: EXPERIMENT_MOOT if hall_only is not SUSTAINED at any grid point and no source arm ENABLES at any grid point

outcomes.moot: report to owner: no arm operates at the feed envelope on this hardware

classes.notes: ENABLES: hall_only not SUSTAINED and the source arm SUSTAINED at that point (R undefined; T and P_bus reported). NOT_SCOREABLE_FACILITY: base p_b above T-PB-MAX (not evidence against any arm). No class names a winner.

preregistration.when: After S1 hardware and facility are known and before the first score-bearing reading (S2 onward).
